title: Detection of PCBs and OCPs in Irtysh River Water Using GC-MS/MS
author: Tang, Chen, et al.
materials: XS205 Dual Range electronic analytical balance
mixed standard solution of PCBs and OCPs

steps.title: Prepare standard solutions
steps.instruction: Dilute the mixed standard solution containing 7 PCBs and 14 OCPs 100‑fold to obtain an intermediate stock solution; then, using isooctane, prepare mixed standard solutions with mass concentrations of 1, 5, 10, 20, 50 and 100 µg/L for later use.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the mixed standard solution 100 times to create the intermediate stock.
Prepare final mixed standard solutions in isooctane at 1, 5, 10, 20, 50, and 100 µg/L.

steps.title: Set up GC‑MS gas phase
steps.instruction: Install an HP‑5MS column (30 m × 0.25 mm × 0.25 µm), set the injection port to 290 °C, use a 1 µL splitless injection, and supply high‑purity helium (≥99.999%) as carrier gas at 1.0 mL/min. After start‑up, open the side valve and washer purging valve 1.0 min later with a purging flow of 30 mL/min, then activate the carrier‑gas saver 2 min later with a flow of 20 mL/min. Program the column temperature: hold 80 °C for 1 min, ramp to 170 °C at 30 °C/min, ramp to 240 °C at 5 °C/min and hold 1 min, finally ramp to 300 °C at 20 °C/min and hold 3 min.

substeps.instruction: Install the HP‑5MS column (30 m × 0.25 mm × 0.25 µm).
Set injection port temperature to 290 °C, injection volume to 1 µL, and mode to splitless.
Supply helium carrier gas (≥99.999%) at 1.0 mL/min.
Turn on side valve and washer purging valve after 1 min; set purging flow to 30 mL/min.
Turn on carrier‑gas saver after 2 min; set flow to 20 mL/min.
Program column temperature: 80 °C hold 1 min → 170 °C at 30 °C/min → 240 °C at 5 °C/min hold 1 min → 300 °C at 20 °C/min hold 3 min.

steps.title: Configure MS parameters
steps.instruction: Set the mass spectrometer to electron impact (EI) mode with ionization energy 70 eV, ion source temperature 300 °C, and transmission line temperature 280 °C; select SRM data‑collection mode, use high‑purity helium (≥99.999%) as collision gas, and set the solvent delay to 8.00 min.
